title: (Pwn2Own) Western Digital MyCloud PR4100 samba Configuration Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Western Digital MyCloud PR4100.
